metadata.description: Engineer of Wealth: agent plugins for builders who ship and want to sell. Paid plugins need a purchase; the buy link is on each plugin's page.

plugins.name: ghost
plugins.description: Your ghostwriter. Learns your voice from 3-5 messages you wrote, then replies, writes and rewrites in it. Always a draft, never sent. Requires purchase.

plugins.name: executor
plugins.description: Spec in, a stack of reviewed PRs out. Today: reviews every pull request, builds it, verifies each finding with its own agent, fixes the confirmed bugs and reviews again. Works best with gh stack. Free, MIT.

plugins.name: cvo
plugins.description: Chief Visual Officer: keeps your visual brand library in order. Audits it, builds characters, objects and locations from its templates, draws and edits scenes, validates every image in a fresh context, designs comic issues, and draws data figures on blueprint sheets. Requires purchase.
